site_name: LAND N/O CHILTERN MAINLINE, E/O RIVER PINN, W/O HIGH ROAD/
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 75317/APP/2019/4141 (refused on 22-05-2020 and allowed at appeal on 18-11-2020) (Request for approval of Plans & Specifications under condition imposed by Schedule 17 to the High Speed Rail (London - West Midlands) Act 2017, relating to the new above-ground section of railway, including the West Ruislip Portal, the Portal Headhouse and Site Compound, substation building, part of the West Ruislip Retained Embankment and associated permanent works, including lighting, earthworks (including retaining walls), boundary / security fencing (location only) and noise barriers) to remove steel posts from the track facing side of the noise barriers.
decision_conditions: Only amendments which are subject to Schedule 17 approval are considered under this application for non-material changes to the design of the  noise barriers in the West Ruislip Portal area. The amendments sought for approval relate to:
- Removal of the steel supports on the track facing side of the noise barriers.

The proposals are considered to represent an approval the authority could have given originally and are considered to be non-material. As such, the application is recommended for approval, in accordance with Schedule 17, Part 1, Paragraph 21 (Non-material changes to approvals), of the High Speed Rail (London - West Midlands) Act 2017.

This approved non-material amendment supersedes approved plan ref. 1MC04-SCJ_SDH-AR-DEL-SS05_SL07-483212 Rev. C01 from application ref. 75317/APP/2019/4141 (refused on 22-05-2020 and allowed at appeal on 18-11-2020) with plan ref. 1MC04-SCJ_SDH-AR-DEL-SS05_SL07-483212 Rev. C02.

Notwithstanding the non-material amendments hereby approved, all other conditions relating to application ref. 75317/APP/2019/4141 (refused on 22-05-2020 and allowed at appeal on 18-11-2020), must be discharged/adhered to as per that permission.
